procedureDecision.captureSurface: Capacitor app display after native wrapper preflight
procedureDecision.browserChromePolicy: Safari UI, URL bars, and browser controls must not appear in final submission screenshots.
procedureDecision.nextGate: Capacitor introduction preflight decision before implementation or capture

cleanDemoAccountPrerequisites: A clean demo account is available and does not expose personal email or account identifiers in the UI.
At least one safe demo script exists for the screenshot flow.
Reusable model audio exists for the Listen screen.
Record can show the English script, Take recording action, and model voice playback bar without technical file details.
At least one Take exists for Review.
Review has a reference score, next-focus guidance, and coach memo in a normal non-loading state.
Progress shows latest take and best take data for the demo script.
Progress can show take memo and replay affordances without overly negative short-recording warning copy when possible.
A default voice exists so Voice setup opens the existing-voice three-choice state.
The account has no visible private paths, raw audio references, Storage object details, provider IDs, tokens, or secrets.

screens.desiredState: Normal logged-in demo state where today's one-minute studio entry is visible.
mustShow: 今日の1分スタジオに入る

screens.desiredState: Normal creation choice state with the three creation options visible.

capacitorCapturePreflightRisks.check: Verify headers, primary CTA, playback controls, and bottom content are not clipped by notches, rounded corners, home indicator, or status bar area.
Confirm app-display viewport matches intended screenshot device size and that text/card hierarchy remains readable without Safari chrome.
Decide status bar appearance before capture and confirm it does not cover app content or create an unintended Store visual.
Check bottom controls, browser-free navigation, and home indicator spacing so CTAs and audio controls are not obscured.
Ensure microphone permission prompts are resolved before final Record capture; permission dialogs must not appear in final screenshots.
Ensure model-audio and saved-take playback can be ready without native permission or autoplay prompts visible in Listen, Review, or Progress screenshots.

redactionNotes: Do not show email, token, private path, raw audio, Storage path, secret, magic link, or account identifier.
Do not show recording filenames, MIME / codec, file size, or storage object metadata.
Do not show provider names or internal IDs.
Do not show misleading actual-deletion-complete wording.
Do not show unimplemented claims such as Brush-up v1.1 as a v1 feature.
Do not show error states, network failure states, or loading-in-progress states.
Do not show Safari UI, URL bars, or browser controls.
Confirm important text is not visibly cut off.
nextStep: Proceed to a Capacitor introduction preflight decision and checklist before any implementation. Do not capture final screenshots until app-display behavior, permissions, safe area, viewport, and redaction readiness have been checked.
